SELECT tick, liquidity_gross, liquidity_net FROM liquidity_positions WHERE pool_id = ?
DELETE FROM liquidity_positions WHERE pool_id = ? AND tick NOT IN (?, ?)

INSERT INTO liquidity_positions (pool_id, tick, liquidity_net, liquidity_gross) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?), (?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (pool_id, tick) DO UPDATE SET liquidity_net = excluded.liquidity_net, liquidity_gross = excluded.liquidity_gross WHERE liquidity_positions.liquidity_net != excluded.liquidity_net OR liquidity_positions.liquidity_gross != excluded.liquidity_gross
DELETE FROM initialization_maps WHERE pool_id = ? AND word NOT IN (?, ?)

INSERT INTO initialization_maps (pool_id, word, bitmap) VALUES (?, ?, ?), (?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (pool_id, word) DO UPDATE SET bitmap = excluded.bitmap WHERE initialization_maps.bitmap != excluded.bitmap
